remotes.description: List of cloud storage remotes (e.g., S3 bucket, Google Drive account). Each remote defines a named instance of a cloud backend.

name.description: Unique identifier for the remote (used as `rclone remote:...`). Must be alphanumeric, with dashes or underscores only.

comment.description: Optional human-readable description (inserted as a comment).

type.description: Rclone backend type (e.g., s3, googlecloudstorage, drive, dropbox, local, azureblob).

options.description: Backend-specific configuration parameters (e.g., `bucket`, `client_id`, `region`, `token`). Keys are backend option names, values are their strings (or numbers).
